resolution.note: pruneCache/cacheOverLimit tested on fixture cache above cap and under free floor

title: Screening verify cache grows without bound (32G) and starves lanes of disk
body:
Evidence 2026-11-16: .krn/tmp/screen-scratch/cache grew to 32G (go-build 13G, go-mod 14G, npm 3.1G) during screening verify; disk fell to 4.1G free and krn lane start refused (KRN_LANE_MIN_FREE_GB=5).
Outcome: evals/units/screening.ts verify keeps its cache under a cap (e.g. prune go-build/go-mod after each Go unit, or a size cap checked between units) and never drives free disk below the lane floor.
Proof: a test runs the cache pruning on a fixture cache dir above the cap and asserts it ends below it.
Files: evals/units/screening.ts
